svg.title: VIS-0001 visual grammar
svg.desc: Legend defining graphical symbols for stocks, flows, states, processes, capacities, environmental conditions, uncertainty, and timescale.
svg.text: The Cost of Life — visual grammar v0.1
A reusable language for showing biological dependencies without turning them into commodity lists.
Stock
Accumulated quantity within a declared boundary.
Example: body water; canonical body-protein inventory.
Flow
Transfer, input, output, production, or throughput.
Crossing the organism boundary does not imply purchase.
Bounded state
Condition that must remain within an admissible range.
Bounds may be known structurally while numeric thresholds remain unresolved.
Process
Activity or transformation through time.
May be continuously required without being a consumable.
Capacity
Ability to perform a process or sustain a flow.
Ability is not the same as realized throughput.
environment
condition
Environmental condition
External condition that enables or constrains viability.
Not automatically a commodity, building, or infrastructure asset.
dashed = unresolved / incomplete / conditional
timeline = dependency-specific horizon, not default daily cadence
